lq.ANSWER:
1. Parallel Computing and Key Models (5 marks)

Parallel computing is the process of executing multiple tasks or data operations simultaneously to improve performance.

  • Data Parallelism: Same operation on different parts of data (e.g., matrix operations).

  • Task Parallelism: Different operations on the same or different data (e.g., modules running in parallel).

2. Shared vs Distributed Memory Architectures (6 marks)

Feature Shared Memory Distributed Memory
Scalability Limited, due to memory contention Highly scalable
Communication Fast via shared variables Slower, needs message passing
Programming Easier (e.g., threads) Complex (e.g., MPI setup)
Cost Cheaper setup Higher setup cost

 

3. Recommendation & Justification (4 marks)

Recommended: Distributed memory
Justification:

  • Weather simulation involves large-scale data across regions.

  • Distributed systems offer better scalability and fault tolerance.

  • Suited for high-performance computing clusters used in simulations.
